[PROMPT TYPE]
MiniMax H3 reference-to-video. Two character reference sheets, no other references. Single continuous 5-second shot, cinematic wuxia live-action realism.

[REFERENCE USE]
Image1: sole identity reference for the male fighter — the black-robed young man in the turnaround sheet: exact face, dark branching seal mark on the forehead center, faint dark crack lines on cheek and neck, long loose black hair half-tied with strands over the face, layered all-black hanfu robe with sheer gauze sleeves, wide dark waist sash, black boots.
Image2: sole identity reference for the female fighter — the teal-robed young woman in the turnaround sheet: exact face, high updo with golden floral hairpins and dangling pearl ornaments, long black hair down the back, deep teal-green layered hanfu with gold-embroidered dark outer coat and red edging, ornate waist belt, pleated skirt.
Each image governs one character only; neither character borrows traits from the other's sheet.

[IDENTITY AND CONTINUITY LOCKS]
The man keeps Image1's face, forehead seal mark, crack lines, hairstyle and all-black robe in every frame; the woman keeps Image2's face, updo, hairpins and teal-green gold-embroidered robe in every frame; weapons stay assigned — man: black straight sword; woman: slender jian — never swapped, never duplicated.

[SCENE]
A vast shan-shui landscape: towering misty karst peaks, a still green lake in the middle ground, a shallow rocky shore in the foreground where the two fight; thin morning mist drifts between mountains; a few tall pines at the water edge; pale early-morning sky. No buildings, no other people.

[SHOT TIMELINE]
0.0–1.5 seconds — Wide framing by the water: the two face each other on the wet stones; the man in black raises his dark blade in a slow cold arc; the woman in teal answers with her jian level, skirts settling; mist curls at their feet.
1.5–3.5 seconds — They close and clash mid-stride, blades ringing with glinting sparks; the woman spins low with her pleated skirt flaring, the man counters with a heavy sweeping block; water droplets kick up from the shallow shore.
3.5–5.0 seconds — They break apart and settle into guarded stances a few paces apart, blades raised toward each other, breath visible in the cool air; mist drifts between them; hold the standoff.

[DIALOGUE AND LIP SYNC]
None — no spoken lines, no lip movement.

[ACTING]
The man fights cold and ruthless, every motion efficient and heavy; the woman fights calm and precise, light-footed; both keep focused combat expressions throughout.

[CAMERA]
16:9 cinematic framing; wide distance keeping both fighters fully readable; one slow lateral tracking move during the clash; no whip pans, no cuts, no zoom pumping, no disorienting shake; mountains and water stay visible in the background throughout.

[LIGHT AND IMAGE]
Soft cool morning light with pale silver rim light on hair, black gauze and gold embroidery; mist catches gentle god rays between peaks; clean transparent image, filmic highlight rolloff, Arri Alexa-like color science, low-saturation cool grade, fine subtle film grain; live-action realistic wuxia drama look — not anime, not 3D, not CG.

[PRODUCTION SOUND]
Clear metallic blade-clash rings, whooshing fabric and blade cuts, quick footwork on wet stone, a soft splash as droplets scatter; thin wind through pines and distant water lapping as ambience. No music, no dialogue, no voice-over.

[CONTINUITY]
Both characters keep the exact faces, hairstyles, costumes and weapons of their reference sheets for the whole shot; the man's forehead mark and crack lines remain visible and unchanged; the woman's hairpins stay fixed; the landscape, mist and light stay consistent.

[NEGATIVES]
No identity drift from either reference sheet, no face swap between the two characters, no extra fighters, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no narration, no background music, no song, no anime / 3D / CG look, no teleporting or floaty weightless motion, no limbs passing through bodies, no duplicated or vanishing weapons, no deformed hands or faces, no flickering costumes, no missing forehead mark mid-shot, no oversaturation, no watermark, no logo, no gore.
